item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces have launched a multi-day military operation in the occupied West Bank, expanding a lockdown, razing a neighbourhood in Hebron and carrying out home demolitions after two Israeli soldiers were shot dead and two gunmen were killed. Simultaneously an Israeli airstrike hit a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, captured on video, and raids in Hebron detained dozens of Palestinians. The United Nations cut food aid, leaving displaced West Bank Palestinians facing growing hunger. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
